messages:
Sofia (People Ops): Quick check for JD before Monday: I-9 remote verification, BG check follow-up (vendor asked for prior addr proof), laptop delivery, benefits enrollment, payroll setup. Who's owning buddy intro?

kyle (Hiring Manager): I'll be on the kickoff call. Marta said she'd do the buddy intro? @marta?

marta (Buddy): Yep I can do buddy. I'll pop into the 9am intro and send a small agenda. :smile:

newhire-jd: Thanks! I'm remote in OR. Can I use an authorized agent for the I-9? I have passport and a WA utility bill.

Sofia (People Ops): Yes — remote authorized agent OK. Please use the secure intake link and complete the agent form so we can finish Section 2. Upload docs there: https://okta.redwood.com/i9/agent-upload

background-bot: Background check status: NEEDS_INFO — vendor requests documentation for previous address (2019-2021). Email sent to newhire-jd@personal.mail.

newhire-jd: Just uploaded the WA utility bill and a signed lease from 2020 to the vendor link. Please confirm if that's sufficient.

Sofia (People Ops): Got it, I'll mark vendor follow-up. If they need anything else I'll escalate.

raj (IT): Laptop order placed (MacBook Pro 14, 32GB). Courier ETA Thu 6pm PT. Tracking: https://ship.example/ZX9876. Note: we require a quick selfie with ID for device assignment. Upload goes here (expires in 72h): https://secure.redwood.com/dev-upload

device-bot: Device acceptance pending for newhire-jd. Reminder scheduled in 24h.

lisa (Benefits): Benefits enrollment portal: https://benefits.redwood.com/start — enroll within 30 days, or default elections apply. I'll DM the summary of plans and the link to the FSA form.

Sofia (People Ops): Payroll/direct deposit also pending. Please complete tax & bank info: https://payroll.redwood.com/onboard (needed before first paycheck).

kyle (Hiring Manager): Access requests needed: GitHub (dev), Slack, and dev AWS. Approving now.

raj (IT): Approved by kyle, provisioning in progress. Will post 1Password notes once creds ready.

newhire-jd: Thanks everyone — uploaded selfie+ID and confirmed vendor docs. Any other blockers?

Sofia (People Ops): All tracked. I'll create #welcome-jd and a small onboarding doc for Day 1 links. Welcome aboard! :tada:
